claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_sense_range
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has conditional sense math: it grants Darkvision if absent, but otherwise increases an existing Darkvision range by 60 feet. That is not representable as grant_sense alone without losing the additive rider.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you already have Darkvision, wearing the goggles increases its range by 60 feet.
